text: On the chat_preference testbed, we evaluated a weak-to-strong training pipeline that pairs a learned noisy-channel model of weak-label errors with frozen strong-model margin priors, refined through two rounds of EM. The single reported metric is a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.78. This figure should be read with substantial caution. No baseline PGR was supplied, so we cannot characterize the result as an improvement over any comparison method, nor can we say how much of the 0.78 is attributable to the noisy-channel component, the margin priors, or the EM refinement, since no ablations were run. The configuration also omits num_seeds, meaning the number of independent runs behind the 0.78 is unknown, and no standard error or variance estimate accompanies it; the value may therefore reflect a single run and could shift under reseeding. Additional runs with seed counts recorded, a stated baseline, and component ablations are needed before drawing inferences about the method's effectiveness.
